section.content: 本实用新型涉及种生物基因观测仪器，包括观测箱和观测目镜筒，所述观测箱上分别安装有保温盒和透明防护盒，所述保温盒的左端安装有空心管，所述透明防护盒的右端安装有侧盒，所述侧盒的下端通过软管安装有冷藏箱，所述空心管与侧盒的材质均为塑料，所述空心管与保温盒之间通过螺纹相连接，所述空心管与观测箱安装有连接套，所述侧盒与透明防护盒通过螺栓相连接。本实用新型通过设置观测箱、保温盒、透明防护盒、冷藏箱有助于分类安装观测、保温和冷藏仪器及器具防护，通过设置侧盒、空心管和观测目镜筒有助于控制线穿接、安装电控元件和观测生物制备样品。

This utility model is related to a kind of biological gene observation instrument, including observing case and observation eyepiece stalk, incubation chamber and transparent protection box is separately installed with the observation case, the left end of the incubation chamber is provided with hollow pipe, the right-hand member of the transparent protection box is provided with side box, the lower end of the side box is provided with cold closet by flexible pipe, the hollow pipe is plastics with the material of side box, it is connected by screw thread between the hollow pipe and incubation chamber, the hollow pipe is provided with adapter sleeve with observation case, and the side box is connected by bolt with transparent protection box.This utility model contributes to classification and installs observation, insulation and cold preservation instrument and utensil protection by arranging observation case, incubation chamber, transparent protection box, cold closet, contributes to control line and wear connecing, installing electric control element and observe biology and prepare sample by arranging side box, hollow pipe and observation eyepiece stalk.

A kind of biological gene observation instrumentTechnical field

This utility model is related to biological gene device design technical field, more particularly to a kind of biological gene observation instrument.

Background technology

Biological engineering is based on biological theory and technology, in conjunction with the modern times such as chemical industry, machinery, electronic computer work Journey technology, fully with the last word of molecular biology, ground manipulates hereditary material, directionally transforms biological or its function, short The new species with super remote edge character are createed in phase, then by suitable bioreactor to this kind of " engineering bacteria " or " engineering Cell strain " is cultivated on a large scale, emerging to produce a large amount of desirable metabolites or play their unique physiological functions one Technology.Genetic engineering is with molecular genetics as theoretical basiss, is given birth to molecule also known as gene splicing technology and DNA recombinant techniques Thing and microbiological modernism are means, by the gene of separate sources by the blueprint being pre-designed, build in vitro miscellaneous DNA molecular is planted, living cells are then introduced into, to change biological original inherited character, obtain new varieties, production new product.Gene Engineering technology provides strong means for the research of the 26S Proteasome Structure and Function of gene.However, existing biological gene observation instrument On lack contribute to classify install observation, insulation and cold preservation instrument and utensil protection device, some biological gene observation instruments On lack and contribute to control line and wear connecing, electric control element being installed and observation biology prepares the device of sample, it is impossible to meet practical situation Demand.

Utility model content

The purpose of this utility model is to overcome the deficiencies in the prior art, there is provided a kind of biological gene observation instrument.

This utility model is to be achieved through the following technical solutions：

A kind of biological gene observation instrument, including observing case and observation eyepiece stalk, is separately installed with guarantor on the observation case Warm box and transparent protection box, the left end of the incubation chamber are provided with hollow pipe, and the right-hand member of the transparent protection box is provided with side box, The lower end of the side box is provided with cold closet by flexible pipe, and the hollow pipe is plastics with the material of side box.

As optimal technical scheme of the present utility model, it is connected by screw thread between the hollow pipe and incubation chamber, institute State hollow pipe, with observation case, adapter sleeve is installed.

Used as optimal technical scheme of the present utility model, the side box is connected by bolt with transparent protection box, described Observation eyepiece stalk is installed in the upper end of observation case, and the left side positioned at transparent protection box.

Used as optimal technical scheme of the present utility model, the observation case is shaped as cuboid.

During onsite application, device is moved integrally correct position by operator first, then device is integrally fixed, its Secondary, by observing case, incubation chamber, transparent protection box, cold closet classification installation observation, insulation and cold preservation instrument and protective device, Finally, wear to connect control line, electric control element is installed and observes biology by side box, hollow pipe and observation eyepiece stalk and prepare sample, i.e., Biological gene observation work can be carried out.

Compared with prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are：This utility model is by arranging observation case, insulation Box, transparent protection box, cold closet contribute to classification install observation, insulation and cold preservation instrument and utensil protection, by arrange side box, Hollow pipe and observation eyepiece stalk contribute to control line wear connect, installs electric control element and observe biology prepare sample, and simple structure, Easy to operate, economical and practical.
